fusions.name: Swarm Pass
fusions.desc: A swarm of moths sweeps round you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Stripped Selvedge
fusions.desc: Gnaws at the target's armour, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Moth Cloud
fusions.desc: Calls a cloud of moths woven from thread for 14 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 6 tiles every second for 3 damage.

fusions.name: Moth-Eaten Hem
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
